kinematic_sweep.note: Fixed HOME display cans are only a diagnostic; see continuous_can_barrier_proof.moving_can_handoff for the kinematic acceptance proof.

continuous_can_barrier_proof.model: Ø48 can centre constrained to deck line n=24; Ø4 circular finger

moving_can_handoff.model: can 1 follows front upstream boundary; packed can 2 transfers to rear upstream boundary; no friction/timing assumption

gate_planes_and_cans_home_mm.note: Пальцы стоят в плоскостях затворов: перед первой банкой и между первой/второй, не над центрами.

force_validation.model: quasi-static frictionless Ø4/Ø48 contact; exact four-bar derivative; peak limit, not average, determines table

power_safety.external_signal_pulldown: 10 kΩ from each servo signal to GND
power_safety.continuous_pwm_requirement: while any can remains in the channel, valid calibrated 50 Hz PWM must remain continuously present in HOME, EJECT and during motion; servo power alone is not a holding command
startup: boot ESP32 and hold all servo signal pins LOW
start valid 50 Hz PWM and command calibrated HOME
shutdown: fully unload every can from the channel
stop PWM only after servo 5 V is absent

force_validation.warning: Peak table is quasi-static. Friction, impacts and print flex require a one-lane endurance test; loaded power loss is not safe.

mounting_and_support_chain.attachment: A01+A04 clamp the common lower-sheet front edge with two M4 screws outside the sheet; no sheet holes

servo_snap_fit.note: Side walls flex only during insertion; the ears occupy non-intersecting capture pockets in the installed position.

production_blocker: Prototype endurance and power-loss containment remain unverified; 22×200 g exceeds the 0.06 N·m target.
